prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve, style-transfer.
This is the final corrective redraw for Lin Gang, a male forest warden in his THIRTIES. Image 1 is the first portrait to revise; Image 2 is the original identity reference; Images 3–6 are tight-head pixel portrait style examples only.
KEEP the same clean-shaven, lean angular face, long thin angular nose, strong cheek plane, warm skin, dark brown hair, quiet concentrated listening expression and slight three-quarter look toward viewer-left. Keep the moss-olive plain low-brim cap, moss-green short cape edge and tiny brown tunic neckline, without badges or feathers. Do not turn him older, broader-faced, noble, threatening or sorrowful.
MAKE ONE COHERENT FRAMING CORRECTION: much larger FACE, drastically smaller cap crown, almost no neck, only a thin collar edge. The first portrait leaves too much cap and neck. RECOMPOSE the anatomy, do not crop away existing cap/hair/ear. Imagine an actual 74 by 100 pixel canvas: the complete compact flat cap occupies y=3–18; forehead starts around y=17; eyes around y=34; nose down to y=58; long jaw and chin reach y=88; the small supporting neck occupies only y=89–92; narrow green/brown collar ends y=96. Face should be roughly 52 pixels wide. There are NO shoulders, chest or wide cape folds. The head must stay naturally lean; make the frame a face close-up, not a bust.
The FULL source silhouette, including low brim tip, all side hair and ear, must have real transparent clearance of at least 3 logical pixels at both sides and above. No item may end at an image border. Reduce the cap and hair volume to achieve that, never clip them.
Eyes need the same listening direction but smaller and darker: tiny shadowed dark almond slits, muted warm gray sclera only a 1-pixel sliver, no broad white blocks or glints. Brows mostly level and intent, mouth closed without a downturned pleading look. No new deep wrinkles or heavy bags.
Pixel construction must visibly match the style examples: big connected blocks shaping nose, cheekbone, forehead and jaw, clear stepped edges, few major brown hair masses. At most 32 flat earthy colors. Hard edge low-resolution pixel art intent, no smooth shading, gradients, antialiasing, blur, dither, line-by-line hair stripes, tiny noise, texts, frame, props or background. Transparent background. One portrait only.
